name: Hackfest
subtitle: Build the rig. Break the corp.
localizedDescription:
You were fired from CorpoMax. Time for payback.

Start with an empty desk and a budget. Order parts, assemble the tower (every watt and every gigabyte counts, and without a network card you are not getting online), image an operating system and boot into HackfestOS. Then go to work on CorpoMax.

• Crack firewalls to get a foothold on the network
• Read the logs: real employee names are in there, and tracing them is how you find the next way in
• Every layer of the network is a lock with a real answer
• Seed malware that earns while you sleep, and spend it on hardware that cracks faster

iPhone beta: everything is a tap; typing fields bring up the keyboard.

versions.localizedDescription: - The main menu's Exit, the desktop start menu's Quit and the phone's Quit Game are gone on iPhone (an iPhone app is closed by swiping it away). The PC keeps all three.
